    assert triangle_area(3, 4, 5) == 6.0  # right triangle
    assert triangle_area(5, 5, 6) == 12.0  # isosceles
    assert triangle_area(2, 2, 2) == 1.73  # equilateral: sqrt(3) = 1.73

    # Invalid / degenerate triangles -> -1
    assert triangle_area(1, 2, 3) == -1  # a + b <= c
    assert triangle_area(2, 2, 4) == -1  # degenerate
    assert triangle_area(1, 10, 12) == -1
    assert triangle_area(0, 5, 5) == -1  # zero side
    assert triangle_area(-1, 2, 2) == -1  # negative side
